ItemID: unavailable; Title: Power Pro 48600 Wood Screws, #9 x 3", Premium Outdoor Deck Screws, Rust Resistant, Epoxy Coated Bronze, 1lb Box, 83 pcs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a deck or outdoor woodworking project that calls for these screws right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld 8271 KwikWeld Professional Size Steel Reinforced Epoxy Twin Pack - 10 oz.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Repair adhesive interests me, but this large pack feels excessive without a specific repair planned.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SOLEJAZZ Workbench Caster kit 660 LBS Heavy Duty Retractable Casters Workbench Wheels All Steel Construction Urethane, Bonus Install Template, 4 Casters; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My handtruck purchase does not mean I currently need to make a heavy workbench mobile.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for small durable repairs, which fits my past purchases of repair tapes and vinyl cement.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gorilla Max Strength Clear Construction Adhesive, 9 Ounce Cartridge, Clear, (Pack of 1); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My Gorilla tape purchases make this interesting, but I would wait until I need construction adhesive for a particular job.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 3" Swivel Caster Wheels with Safety Dual Locking and Polyurethane Foam No Noise Wheels, Heavy Duty - 250 Lbs Per Caster (Pack of 4); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current cart-building or wheel-replacement need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: TICONN 480 Pcs T-Tap Wire Connectors, Self-Stripping Quick Splice Electrical Wire Terminals, Insulated Male Quick Disconnect Spade Terminals Assortment Kit with Storage Case (480); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Electrical connectors fit my interests, but I already bought a substantial assortment and have no clear need for T-taps now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 5/16"-18 Stainless Hex Nut (100 Pack), by Bolt Dropper, 304 18-8 Stainless Steel Nuts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would only buy this many nuts if a project required that exact thread size.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: BOMEI PACK Mono Filament Strapping Tape, 2 Roll 2 Inch x 35 Yards 5.5 Mil, Heavy Duty Transparent Reinforced Fiberglass Tape; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for bundling and securing materials; its reinforced construction offers a useful complement to my duct tape.
